text:
Aisha: Heads-up: main is red on the typecheck/lint gate after the shared pre-commit bump. CI shows failures across pyright, eslint, and rustfmt on different runners. Please hold merges until we triage.

ci-bot: Build summary: run 4819 failed on merge commit 0a1b2c3 — jobs failing: typecheck(pyright) linux-x86, lint(eslint) node12, rustfmt mismatch macos. Tests passed. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4819/logs

Ben: Can someone repro locally? Try: `git checkout main && git pull && pre-commit run --all-files`

Maya: I ran pre-commit locally — eslint is erroring on `no-explicit-any` in a few TS files. The rule was introduced in the shared config change Mike pushed yesterday (commit abcdef1).

Sam: Pyright is complaining about a couple of Optional accesses in py files (reportOptionalMemberAccess) after a stricter flag got turned on in pyrightconfig.json. Seems the shared config bumped strictness for both JS/TS and Python.

Mike: I landed the stricter rules to reduce tech debt. Didn't expect it to flip the gate for all repos at once. Happy to revert if it's blocking. Which files are failing?

Ben: Example pyright snippet: ```
src/lib/cache.py:45: error: Item "None" of "Optional[Cache]" has no attribute "get" (reportOptionalMemberAccess)
```

Maya: Example eslint error: `src/components/parser.ts: Unexpected any. (no-explicit-any)` — multiple small files.

Aisha: Two quick options: revert the shared config commit so main is green, or add temporary workspace exemptions (ignoreFiles / overrides) and iterate. Revert is faster for now.

Ben: Agree revert first. Then we can roll the stricter rules incrementally per package.

Aisha: @ci-bot can you queue a rerun for the merge commit and for the rollback candidate once it's up? Also attach full pyright/eslint logs.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by Aisha: queued jobs: 4822(typecheck), 4823(lint). Links: https://ci.internal/runs/4822 , https://ci.internal/runs/4823

Sam: I'll do a quick bisect if needed. First step: test reverting the eslint portion only (it's the most red). If that fixes lint we don't need to touch pyright.

Mike: I'm opening a rollback PR that reverts the shared config commit (PR #3426) and will ping when it's ready.

ci-bot: Run 4822 (typecheck) finished: green. Run 4823 (lint) finished: red. Eslint still failing. Full lint logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4823/logs

Maya: That confirms eslint change is the immediate blocker. Thanks for the quick bisect, Sam.

Mike: Rollback PR #3426 created and requested for review. Link: https://scm.internal/r/3426

Ben: Once PR is merged can someone trigger a full-gate rerun and if green merge any queued PRs.

ci-bot: Rollback PR merged by Mike (merge commit d4e5f6). Triggering post-merge pipeline: run 4830 queued. https://ci.internal/runs/4830

ci-bot: Run 4830 finished: all gate jobs green. Main is green again.

Aisha: Nice quick turnaround — we'll reopen a smaller, staged rollout for the stricter rules. Mike, let's coordinate the incremental plan so each team can adjust.

Mike: Will follow up with a rollout plan and per-team exemptions. Sorry for the disruption, and thanks for the triage help. :tada:
